themes_detail.label: Park Safety Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Park-related complaints have spiked dramatically this week in Jackson Heights/Corona, with noise complaints up 647% (14 this week vs. 1.9 weekly average) and park rule violations up 1233% (5 this week vs. 0.4 weekly average), suggesting a sudden deterioration in park conditions or a specific incident triggering enforcement.
evidence: Noise - Park complaints: 14 THIS WEEK vs. 1.9 weekly average (z-score: 7.17, 647% spike)
Violation of Park Rules: 5 THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 6.65, 1233% spike)
Aligns with repeated community board budget requests for 'park maintenance and safety'
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Department about what triggered the sudden spike; visit parks to observe conditions firsthand
Talk to residents and park users about safety concerns; determine if incident-driven or systemic deterioration

themes_detail.label: Dead Trees & Urban Decay
themes_detail.summary: Dead and dying tree complaints surged 554% this week in CD 403 (9 complaints this week vs. 1.4 weekly average), the highest statistical anomaly in the dataset, suggesting either a weather event, pest outbreak, or tree maintenance crisis.
evidence: Dead/Dying Tree complaints: 9 THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average (z-score: 10.96, 554% spike)
Highest z-score among all spikes detected, indicating statistical rarity
Aligns with long-standing community board request for 'park maintenance' funding
reporting_angles: Check with Parks Department about recent storms, pests (e.g., spotted lanternfly), or disease outbreak affecting trees
Map the 9 complaints to identify geographic cluster; investigate if concentrated in specific park or neighborhood block

themes_detail.label: Building Code Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/use complaints jumped 117% this week (16 complaints this week vs. 7.4 weekly average), the fourth-largest spike detected, paired with 288 DOB permit filings over 90 days, suggesting increased construction activity, code enforcement, or illegal conversions.
evidence: Building/Use complaints: 16 THIS WEEK vs. 7.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.47, 117% spike)
288 DOB permit filings in last 90 days (234 alterations, 19 new buildings, 5 demolitions)
Community board has repeated requests for 'DOB expense budget' support, indicating systemic enforcement gaps
reporting_angles: Analyze the 234 alterations filed—are they conversions or subdivisions of residential units? Check for illegal SROs or rooming houses.
Interview DOB about complaint patterns; are violations concentrated in specific buildings or areas? Why the spike this week?

themes_detail.label: Structural Defects & Safety Issues
themes_detail.summary: Door/window and elevator complaints both spiked recently (94% and 113% respectively), with door/window at 17 complaints 3 weeks ago and elevator at 8 this week, indicating potential building envelope or mechanical system failures affecting resident habitability.
evidence: Elevator complaints: 8 THIS WEEK vs. 3.8 weekly average (z-score: 3.9, 113% spike)
Door/Window complaints: 17 (3 weeks ago) vs. 8.8 weekly average (z-score: 3.92, 94% spike)
Both signal maintenance deficits in aging housing stock, core issue for CD 403
reporting_angles: Cross-check elevator spike with DOB inspection data; are failures concentrated in rent-stabilized or market-rate buildings?
Interview residents about impact on mobility/safety; determine if complaints correlate with specific buildings or landlords

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Accumulation
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints spiked 482% this week (8 complaints this week vs. 1.4 weekly average), suggesting a localized pest or sanitation crisis requiring immediate public health investigation.
evidence: Dead Animal complaints: 8 THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.03, 482% spike)
Geographic and temporal concentration suggests concentrated source (rats, pigeons, or other vectors)
Potential canary for larger pest or sanitation issue
reporting_angles: Contact DOHMH and Sanitation Department about complaints; map all 8 reports to identify location cluster
Investigate potential root cause: overflowing waste, construction, demolition, or rodent/pest outbreak
